findings.problem: The base salt formation of the compounds of formula (I) is described as a transformation of the invention and no pathway (and no step in any pathway) carries it.
findings.quote: Je nach Art der Substituenten enthalten die Verbindungen der allgemeinen Formel (I) ein acides Proton, das durch Umsetzung mit einer Base entfernt werden kann. Als Basen eignen sich beispielsweise Alkalimetalle, wie Lithium, Natrium und Kalium, Erdalkalimetalle, wie Calcium und Magnesium, Ammoniak und organische Amine. Solche Salze sind ebenfalls Gegenstand der Erfindung.
findings.artifact_says: pathways.json carries 21 step projections across 10 records, none of them a salt formation; the section 'Tautomers and Salts' (00-sections.json lines 109 to 115) produced no pathway at all.
findings.should_be: One further section pathway, ksm 'compound of formula (I)', product its base salt, one step of reaction_class salt_formation with the named base classes as reagents. The section 'Preparation Schemes 1 to 4' is the same section_type (summary_of_invention) and was given nine step records on prose that states no charge, no temperature and no time, so line 113 clears the same bar.

findings.problem: The IMAGE_EXTRACT span on line 105 types the drawing on page image p006 as ten reactions, but p006 draws a four corner tautomeric equilibrium (four structures joined by double headed equilibrium arrows, including a diagonal cross), which is not ten reactions and is not a synthesis at all; all four drawn structures were also missed.
findings.artifact_says: pathways.json emits no record from this span, which is the correct outcome; the defect is in the source the annotation was built from, not in a pathway record.
findings.should_be: The span should be typed as a tautomer equilibrium and not as ten reactions, so that a re-run cannot mistake ten arrowheads for ten synthetic steps. Verified by opening input/pages/p006.png; the text immediately under it reads 'Fuer den Fall, dass R6 fuer Hydroxy steht, sind folgende tautomeren Strukturen moeglich' at line 111.

checks_passed.check: vocabulary - rule 14 tag union and closed lists
checks_passed.what_was_verified: Recomputed the union for all 10 records from every step's tags plus the tags of the ksm, each intermediate and the product record in compounds.json plus chain_length:N. Exact match on membership and on first seen ordering, with no missing and no extra tag. All 21 tag categories and every value checked against the closed lists in A1-compounds.md and A2-reactions.md: compound_class, solvent_class, catalyst_class, workup_type, purification, safety, step_role, linkage, is_one_pot, mechanism, scale and functional_group are all in list, no value outside its list, no case mismatch, every tag matches category:value with a lowercase snake_case ASCII value. chain_length, branching, convergence and lcl are present on all 10 and correct: 9 steps gives lcl:long, 3 and 1 give lcl:short.

Every step level validation_flag has a corresponding pathway level flag on every record that contains that step: molar_mass_inconsistent to molar_mass_inconsistent_in_chain, scale_discontinuity to scale_discontinuity_in_chain, no_conditions to no_conditions_for_any_step, cross_reference_unresolved to cross_reference_unresolved_in_chain, a1_missing_compound to a1_missing_compound_in_chain. No pathway is presented clean out of flagged steps. a1_missing_compound_in_chain on record 2 was verified independently: of the 21 distinct step components in the artifact, exactly one, 'cyanide source', has no record in compounds.json, and it belongs to that step. truncated_chain is correctly absent from record 2 alone, because line 353 states 'Die Dicarbonylverbindungen der Formel (II) sind entweder kommerziell erhältlich', while records 3 to 8 start from Markush formulae that are not, and all six carry it. inconsistent_step_arithmetic is correctly absent everywhere because no step carries mass_balance_implausible.

Checked every conditions object against its line. The range at line 556, 'bei 15-20 °C zu einer Suspension ... getropft', was neither flattened to a point nor dropped: it is carried in the acetyl chloride addition_profile because it governs only the dropwise addition, and conditions.temperature is room_temperature from 'ueber Nacht bei Raumtemperatur'. Reflux is never recorded as a temperature: Example 1 Steps 5, 6, 7 and 8 and Example 2 Steps 1 and 2 all carry heating_method 'reflux' with temperature not_specified or room_temperature. Units are handled correctly: '1.5 d' at line 563 becomes time_h 36.0, '0,5 h' at line 548 is held in the iodomethane addition_profile rather than time_h, and the 300 W lamp at line 569 becomes light_source.power_w 300.0 rather than a temperature.
